title: スワンSの後に・強くおっきく！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She comes out of the race happy and satisfied because she was able to run at a much more relaxed pace than usual.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Mile Ch., fall's biggest event where the best racers gather to test their mettle, is up next!
